automatic: The output has exactly one video stream.
The duration matches the approved source within one source frame plus 20 milliseconds.
Source audio is present in the output whenever the source contains audio.
The selected ingredient role is recorded as featured-product or hero-product.
The input and output SHA-256 hashes are recorded.
visual: The approved video remains recognizable and is not distorted.
The three left-side assets are clean, readable, and vertically balanced.
The arrow clearly communicates ingredients becoming output.
No logo, product, or offering is clipped.
The complete video is watched before final approval.
failurePolicy: Never finalize a failed automatic inspection.
Never silently replace a missing featured product with an invented asset.
Never mutate or rerender the source Format.
